<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918380_theRebbe_210" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918380_theRebbe_210__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the difference between the revelation achieved through subjugation and transformation, and applies this to explain why the month of Iyar is called "Ziv" due to the patriarchs' radiance manifesting after their birth in Nissan.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">Now, just as it is regarding the revelation that brings about subjugation and transformation,</t>
    <t s="3">that the advantage of the revelation that brings about subjugation is that it is a more elevated revelation, and the advantage of the revelation that brings about transformation is that it is drawn into the inwardness of the person</t>
    <t s="4">[which is why it is an enduring thing85],</t>
    <t s="5">so too is it regarding the revelation drawn through the service of subjugation and transformation,</t>
    <t s="6">that the advantage of the revelation drawn through the service of subjugation is a most elevated revelation</t>
    <t s="7">[and as mentioned above in section 8, that the light drawn through subjugation is equally in all worlds,</t>
    <t s="8">a light that is above relation to worlds],</t>
    <t s="9">and the advantage of the revelation drawn through the service of transformation is that its drawing into the person and into the world is in a manner of inwardness.</t>
    <t s="10">And based on this, we can explain what Rashi said86</t>
    <t s="11">that this month of Iyar is called Ziv because in it were born the radiances of the world</t>
    <t s="12">(even though the Patriarchs were born in Nissan87)</t>
    <t s="13">— it is because when Iyar was renewed, they had already been born in Nissan,</t>
    <t s="14">for it needs to be understood:</t>
    <t s="15">Behold, this that in the month of Iyar there were the radiances of the world is only a result of the fact that they were born in the month of Nissan,</t>
    <t s="16">so why is Iyar called by the name Ziv88?</t>
    <t s="17">And we can offer the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="18">that the concept of the radiance,</t>
    <t s="19">the revelation drawn through service,</t>
    <t s="20">is that it should illuminate in the world in inwardness and settlement,</t>
    <t s="21">and the revelation of the Patriarchs</t>
    <t s="22">(the radiances of the world)</t>
    <t s="23">in inwardness and settlement in the world was in the month after they were born,</t>
    <t s="24">when Iyar was renewed, they had already been born.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section distinguishes between the revelation drawn through the service of the righteous and that drawn through repentance, explaining that repentance draws the Essence of Ein Sof while the righteous' service brings revelation into the world in a settled way.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And similarly is the distinction between the revelation drawn through the service of the righteous and the revelation drawn through the service of repentance,</t>
    <t s="3">that regarding the level of the revelation — the revelation drawn through the service of repentance is more elevated,</t>
    <t s="4">but the drawing down below into the world</t>
    <t s="5">(in inwardness and settlement)</t>
    <t s="6">is through the service of the righteous.</t>
    <t s="7">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="8">that since the concept of repentance is that the person exits his own existence,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore,</t>
    <t s="10">through repentance there is a drawing of the Essence of Ein Sof that is above the category of existence.</t>
    <t s="11">For the light drawn through the service of the righteous is a light within the category of revelation.</t>
    <t s="12">And even when their service is in self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="13">the drawing through this service is a more elevated drawing,</t>
    <t s="14">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="15">it is within the category of revelation.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is "the humble shall add to be glad in Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="17">that through the humility and self-nullification of the righteous, an additional light is drawn in Havayah, because the drawing is from Ein Sof that is above Havayah,</t>
    <t s="18">but nevertheless, even this drawing is within the category of revelation</t>
    <t s="19">[and as mentioned above in section 3, that the concept of "the humble shall add to be glad in Havayah" is the drawing of the aspect of "My greatness" that is above "your greatness,"</t>
    <t s="20">for the concept of greatness</t>
    <t s="21">(even the aspect of "My greatness")</t>
    <t s="22">relates to expansion and revelation],</t>
    <t s="23">and the concept of this drawing is that through it there will be addition in the revelation of Havayah</t>
    <t s="24">("shall add... in Havayah").</t>
    <t s="25">And the drawing of the aspect of "Holy One of Israel,"</t>
    <t s="26">the Essence that is separate from revelation,</t>
    <t s="27">is through the service of repentance.</t>
    <t s="28">And this can be explained based on what is known89</t>
    <t s="29">that the concept of humility is</t>
    <t s="30">(not that one does not know his own virtues, but rather)</t>
    <t s="31">that even though he knows his virtues, nevertheless he does not take credit for himself because he knows that the virtues he has were given to him from Above.</t>
    <t s="32">And since the self-nullification of humility does not negate his existence</t>
    <t s="33">(for he knows his virtues)</t>
    <t s="34">but rather his existence is not from himself but only from Divinity,</t>
    <t s="35">therefore, even the drawing through the self-nullification of humility is a revelation in the world</t>
    <t s="36">(existence),</t>
    <t s="37">except that the revelation in the world is as it is from its source,</t>
    <t s="38">the aspect of "My greatness."</t>
    <t s="39">And in order to draw the aspect of "Holy One of Israel" that is separate from revelation,</t>
    <t s="40">it is through the self-nullification of "the impoverished of man,"</t>
    <t s="41">that through the feeling that he is impoverished,</t>
    <t s="42">that he has no virtue whatsoever90,</t>
    <t s="43">he is nullified from his existence,</t>
    <t s="44">and through this the aspect of "Holy One of Israel" is drawn.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that while repentance draws the Essence, making a dwelling place in the lower worlds is specifically through the service of the righteous, and the verse "Who would give you as a brother to me" alludes to the integration of both paths.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">B)</t>
    <t s="2">Now, all this is regarding the drawing itself.</t>
    <t s="3">But in order for there to be revelation in the world,</t>
    <t s="4">a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="5">it is through the service of the righteous91.</t>
    <t s="6">For the concept of a dwelling place in the lower worlds is that there should be a revelation of Divinity as it is in Its existence,</t>
    <t s="7">and since the concept of repentance is that one exits his existence</t>
    <t s="8">[in addition to the nullification of his existence,</t>
    <t s="9">as above],</t>
    <t s="10">therefore the concept of a dwelling place in the lower worlds is through the service of the righteous.</t>
    <t s="11">And this is "Who would give you as a brother to me, like Yosef to Binyamin,"</t>
    <t s="12">that even though the request is that the Holy One, blessed be He, should be to us as a brother even though our conduct was not proper,</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless we ask that it be like Yosef to Binyamin,</t>
    <t s="14">and we can say,</t>
    <t s="15">that this hints,</t>
    <t s="16">that even the service of repentance should be in a manner that the revelation through repentance</t>
    <t s="17">(which is above the category of existence)</t>
    <t s="18">should be drawn into the world in settlement,</t>
    <t s="19">the advantage of the righteous,</t>
    <t s="20">like Yosef to Binyamin.</t>
    <t s="21">And this is also the connection of the two interpretations of "Who would give you as a brother to me" that it refers to the righteous and that it refers to penitents</t>
    <t s="22">(as above in section 4),</t>
    <t s="23">that there should be the connection and integration of the two concepts.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
